decision: 0115 refuses (RAISE) when certification_certificates holds a row without issued_on, approved_draft_version_id or a true independence_attested, then sets both columns NOT NULL and tightens the checks
why: The table is immutable (0107 trigger) and nothing is deployed, so old rows cannot be rewritten and must not get an invented issue date

decision: Keep the Certificate independence attestation and require it as literal true (API, web reader, DB values check) instead of dropping the column
why: Issuance already requires it; draft approvals and revisions keep the same literal-true attestation, and the Case page shows it as an attested fact
evidence: #1344 AC4; certification-decision.ts certificateCommand; certification_certificate_revisions values check

decision: Earlier upgrade proofs stop at their own boundary (0108 attestation) or drop the pre-circuit Case (0113 revisions); the 0112 proof becomes the 0115 refusal and upgrade proof
why: Migrating to head now refuses the pre-circuit rows those proofs inserted; the general upgrade-proof policy (#1343 A6) awaits the owner
